meaning:
1) a moment
adv
2) for a moment, at one moment...at another moment
with prep
3) in a moment

elsewhere.note: Yahweh had said to Moses, “Tell the children of Israel, ‘You are a stiff-necked people. If I were to go up among you for one moment, I would consume you.…
“Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”
Now for a little moment grace has been shown from Yahweh our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may…
that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?
May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.
Come, my people, enter into your rooms, and shut your doors behind you. Hide yourself for a little moment, until the indignation is past.
Destruction on destruction is decreed, for the whole land is laid waste. Suddenly my tents are destroyed, and my curtains gone in a moment.
For the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the sin of Sodom, which was overthrown as in a moment. No hands were laid on her.
